note: Port de pêche (B24, harbour site) entrance at the end of the Quai des Grands Départs, camera on the quay facing east to the sea. Navy wrought-iron gate shaped like half a ship's wheel between two anchor-topped stone pillars; harbour, fishing boats and the striped lighthouse beyond. Painted 2026-10-22.
